assets.prompt: Realistic game sprite sheet of one chonky juvenile Weddell seal, FOUR swim poses in a precise 2x2 grid on a 1536x1024 TRANSPARENT RGBA PNG. Each 768x512 cell contains a complete right-facing pup with identical head/body placement, neutral lighting. Big plump oval body, round short face with folds, soft fine wet silver-gray mottled fur, pale cream cheeks and belly, glossy dark eyes near blunt dark nose, whiskers, short front flippers, no ear flaps. Rear anatomy MUST visibly have THREE DISTINCT PARTS: two broad vertical webbed hind flippers AND a small pointed triangular TAIL between them. The tail is a light-gray tapered wedge extending left from rump only 35 pixels, its tip surrounded by clear transparent gaps above and below, unoutlined root, NOT a rod. Each hindflipper extends 100 pixels back and is a broad upright fan with five webbed toes; the two fan surfaces are parallel, near/far depth planes, slightly offset so they can both be seen. This is NOT one bifurcated tail; the short third central wedge MUST be visible in every pose. Subtle side-to-side stroke changes the apparent widths of the two rear paddles across the four frames; torso and head are fixed, never turning up or down. Swimming side view, with slight three-quarter perspective. Frame animal extents x40..720 y110..415. Entire animal within each cell, generous margins. Scientific naturalistic illustration with photoreal fur. Genuinely transparent background, ALPHA ZERO outside the animal. Absolutely no checkerboard, water, sky, snow, ground, backdrop, gradient, shadow, gridlines, text or marks.
assets.referenceUse: User Weddell pup photographs informed round head, neck folds, grey/cream coat. Underwater photographs and the cropped paired feet informed paddle orientation and short central tail. Generated from visual description; no reference photograph is shipped.
